facts.business: Gujarat Energy Limited (formerly Gujarat Gas Limited) is engaged in the transmission of natural gas through pipelines and operates as a city gas distribution entity, with subsidiaries and joint ventures developing cross-country natural gas pipeline projects.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (a) Financial statements of joint operations prepared per PSC/JOA requirements with adjustments under Ind AS; (b) Forfeiture notice of JODPL's PI in KG-OSN-2001/3 for Rs 494.81 crore, pending MC approval and NCLAT appeal; (c) Arbitration award against APSEZL for Rs 1,044.90 crore (Rs 1,000 crore capex + Rs 44.90 crore opex), challenged in Bombay High Court; (d) Voluntary liquidation of subsidiary GSPC (JPDA) Ltd commenced via special resolution on 24 Feb 2026.

key_risks: Forfeiture of JODPL's participating interest in KG-OSN-2001/3 block (Rs 494.81 crore) subject to NCLAT appeal and Management Committee approval
Arbitration award of Rs 1,044.90 crore against APSEZL challenged in Bombay High Court under Section 34
PNGRB proceedings against GSPL India Transco Ltd for unilateral reduction of pipeline diameter (18" vs authorized 42") in MBBVPL project
Inability to achieve project milestones for balance phase of MBBVPL project, risking penalty/termination of authorization
Voluntary liquidation of subsidiary GSPC (JPDA) Ltd commenced in February 2026
Tariff uncertainty for partially laid MBBVPL section pending project completion and PNGRB decision
facts.related_party_note: Joint ventures include GSPL India Gasnet Ltd (GIGL) and GSPL India Transco Ltd (GITL) with shareholding: GSPL 52%, IOCL 26%, BPCL 11%, HPCL 11%. Transactions with joint ventures and associates disclosed in consolidated financial statements.
